title: Round 1 · v1
meta: a fresh critic · frames at 2–24 fps, sound by measurement
gap: The thesis beat is told by text rather than acted: told to come in, the dog does nothing you can read as a choice.
repair: In the 2 s after "come in." resolves: (a) the dog visibly reacts, ears or head toward the doorway or the tail moves; (b) then settles back clearly, head onto paws or turned back out; (c) on the last frame part of the body is inside the lit opening and part outside. Legible at 320 px wide with the tags masked.
notes: 33.5 s: a pose and scale snap, lying-and-turned-away to edge-on to standing, on a camera cut.
37.5 s: the reaction to the open door lands while the next prompt is typed.
28–33 s: in the wide shot the turned-away dog is a small lump; only the close-up reads.
5.0–5.9 s: the caption vanishes under the growing picture, then appears twice.
6.0 and 18.0 s: crossfades put text over text.
Tags, diagram subtitles and credits too small for a phone.
"Come in" is the weakest sound cue: mostly a broadband burst.
keep: The cut paper and dusk palette; the P/E/O bar and tags that update; the close-up refusal at 25–28 s; the person sitting; the continuous approach with paws in sync; the door creak; the nesting scales and the lockup.
done: Every cause repaired (see What broke and what changed); round 2 went to a different critic.
